<img class="tool-icon" src="../../../../images/tekla/tools/uweldedmeshrebar.png" alt="" width="48" height="48" style="display:block;margin:0 0 1rem;background:#fff;border-radius:8px;padding:4px" />

{{% callout type="info" %}}
**Where to find it:** Applications & Components → Comma → Rebar → `uWeldedMeshRebar`
{{% /callout %}}

Places welded mesh (rebar mesh and mesh groups) on a slab, with cross-bar placement checked against Tekla's own mesh orientation. In vertical mode the top and bottom covers are bar-surface covers and the cross-bar overhang is measured past the outer face of the longitudinal bar. The tool passes its native suite (3133 checks) and an end-to-end insert and modify test for groups and meshes on Tekla 2026.

<blockquote class="page-note">The Tekla plugin string is <code>uWeldedMeshRebar</code>. Components placed by the earlier Clone builds (<code>uWeldedMeshRebarClone</code>) may not be recognised by it; see <a href="../rebar-upgrade/">Upgrading from the earlier Clone builds</a>. Sets saved under the earlier dialog name are carried over with the <a href="../rebar-upgrade/">preset migration helper</a>.</blockquote>
